name: Adams-Rite Adams Rite Dark Bronze Electric Strike For Exit Devices
description: The 74R1 series Electric Strike is specifically designed for rim exit devices with 3/4 Pullman type latchbolt. It provides remote electrical control and thus allowing door to open without actuation of the exit device. This is a semi-mortised strike for rim exit devices having 3/4" Pullman type bolts without auxiliary bolts. The electric strike opens electrically under 35 lb of preload. - Mfg#74R1-121 Adams-Rite Adams Rite Dark Bronze Electric Strike For Exit Devices
